basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old software developer from Austin, Texas. I've always been fascinated by how different theories explain human behavior, which led me to explore both MBTI and astrology. While I dabble in these communities, my core interest lies in manga and city-building games. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM CST. Currently single, I enjoy solitude but occasionally crave meaningful interactions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and developed a keen interest in human psychology through online courses and personal reading. My curiosity about personality theories stems from a desire to better understand myself and those around me.
